The archetype nodes are not shot types. They carry the lead-wrist face corridor that used to be
a compiled +/-10 degree shift in reference_bands.cpp, so a valid bowed or cupped style is graded
against its own model rather than red-flagged. They sit under full_swing because that is what
they refine; a shot resolves to one of them only when the archetype has been detected.
